noSourceReason.48309: no usable public county-wide cadastral service found. Searched: the ArcGIS Online catalog for county-wide parcels (only city-scale layers exist -- City of Robinson parcels, and City of Waco's McLennan_County_Map which carries voting precincts and commissioner districts and no parcel layer); the TrueAutomation MapSearch org that hosts many Texas CADs (no McLennan service in its 84-service list). gis.mclennancounty.net / .org and maps.mclennancounty.net do not resolve from this host; gis.wacotx.gov answers 404 at the REST root.
